person.name: Karthikeyan Sadayamuthu
person.headline: Autonomous Systems Security
person.statement: I study how autonomous AI agents fail, and build open tools that check their work before it ships: who they act for, what they change, and what they leak.

projects.name: OCBC
projects.title: OCBC: Open Controls Baseline Catalog, a Machine-Readable NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 and FedRAMP Catalog
projects.summary: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 and FedRAMP controls as a machine-readable catalog you can build on.
projects.problem: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, its SP 800-53B baselines and FedRAMP's OSCAL baselines are published separately, so every tool re-parses and re-joins them.
projects.novelty: One enriched JSON catalog merging all three, rebuilt daily and archived as versioned baselines with DOIs.
projects.role: Sole author: designed, built and maintain it.

projects.name: OEBC
projects.title: OEBC: Open Exposure Baseline Catalog, a CVE Exposure Baseline Enriched with EPSS and CISA KEV
projects.summary: A CVE exposure baseline enriched with EPSS scores and CISA KEV data.
projects.problem: CVE severity alone doesn't show what attackers are exploiting; the signals that do (CISA KEV, FIRST EPSS) live in separate feeds.
projects.novelty: A daily, machine-readable catalog joining NVD, EPSS and KEV, with a derived exposure tier per CVE.
projects.role: Sole author: designed, built and maintain it.

projects.name: ControlGate
projects.title: ControlGate: A Pre-Commit and Pre-Merge NIST SP 800-53 Compliance Gate
projects.summary: Checks code changes against NIST 800-53 at pre-commit and PR time, with block or warn verdicts and remediation guidance.
projects.problem: NIST 800-53 and FedRAMP compliance is usually checked at audit time, long after the code that breaks a control has shipped.
projects.novelty: Checks each change at pre-commit and pull-request time across 8 security domains, maps findings to control IDs, and returns block or warn verdicts with remediation. Validated against a suite of deliberately vulnerable projects.
projects.role: Sole author: designed, built and maintain it.

projects.name: ExposureGate
projects.title: ExposureGate: exploited-vulnerability gate for dependency lockfiles in pre-commit and CI
projects.summary: Blocks a change from adding a dependency version with a known, exploited vulnerability, by joining OEBC to the OSV database.
projects.problem: Dependency scanners flag every CVE alike, so the few being actively exploited get lost in the noise.
projects.novelty: Grades only the versions a change adds to its lockfiles, tiering each CVE by OEBC (KEV-listed is critical). Runs offline and fails closed on missing or stale data.
projects.role: Sole author: designed, built and maintain it.

projects.name: OpenCIQ
projects.title: OpenCIQ
projects.summary: Each NIST control gets a live score with the evidence behind it, and FedRAMP SSP and POA&M documents are generated in OSCAL.

projects.name: OpenGPL
projects.title: OpenGPL: Governance Policy Language
projects.summary: A declarative policy language for generative AI agents: what they can access, what they can produce, and the evidence to prove it.
projects.problem: Rules for what a generative AI system may access, produce and prove live in prose policies that software can't check.
projects.novelty: A declarative policy language for AI agents covering access, outputs and compliance evidence, evaluated at runtime and at rest.
projects.role: Sole author: designed, built and maintain it.

projects.name: unasked
projects.title: unasked: see what your coding agent changed that you never asked for
projects.summary: Scores each change a coding agent made against your prompts, then reverts just the ones you never asked for.
projects.problem: You asked for rate limiting; the agent also deleted a header other files use, loosened a test and bumped a dependency, all in the same diff.
projects.novelty: Scores every diff hunk against your request and the agent's stated intent, lists what nobody asked for, and reverts exactly those hunks.
projects.role: Sole author: designed, built and maintain it.

projects.name: mergelock
projects.title: mergelock: a git-native merge gate
projects.summary: Catches conflicts git can't see between parallel AI agent branches, such as changed signatures with new callers.
projects.problem: Two agents edit different files, git merges cleanly, and the build breaks, because one changed a signature and the other added a caller.
projects.novelty: Compares branches before they merge and reports the conflicts git can't see: changed signatures with new callers, deleted symbols still in use, duplicated functions.
projects.role: Sole author: designed, built and maintain it.

projects.name: ZeroEgress
projects.title: ZeroEgress: an AI code editor that works offline
projects.summary: An offline AI code editor using local models, so nothing leaves your machine.
projects.problem: AI code editors send code, prompts and telemetry to services you don't control, ruling them out for regulated and air-gapped work.
projects.novelty: Full AI editing (chat, agent, autocomplete) against self-hosted model servers only, with telemetry and cloud features removed and a runtime guard that blocks and logs any other connection.
projects.role: Sole author: designed, built and maintain it.

projects.name: anySQL
projects.title: anySQL: SQL Analytics for AI Systems
projects.summary: Query LLM responses, agent traces and RAG pipelines with standard SQL.
projects.problem: Evidence of how an AI system behaves is split across model calls, agent traces, evaluations and retrieval logs, each in its own tool.
projects.novelty: Logs every AI API call into six canonical tables so they can be joined with standard SQL: cost, quality and attack evidence in one query.
projects.role: Sole author: designed, built and maintain it.

projects.name: OpenEQ
projects.title: OpenEQ
projects.summary: A record of every outbound connection from agents, IDEs and MCP servers, with egress rules and a "what left this machine" report.

projects.name: OpenAPL
projects.title: OpenAPL: Access Policy Language for humans and AI agents
projects.summary: Access policy language for humans and AI agents.
projects.problem: A support agent hands a refund to a refund agent; the gateway sees only the last hop, so nobody can say which human it's for or what a hijacked agent could reach.
projects.novelty: Evaluates the whole delegation chain, from the human through every agent, and returns ALLOW, DENY or REQUIRE_APPROVAL with the entitlements and control references behind it. No LLM sits in the decision path.
projects.role: Sole author: designed, built and maintain it.

projects.name: AgentID
projects.title: AgentID
projects.summary: Cryptographic identities for agents, short-lived task-scoped credentials, and verifiable on-behalf-of chains.

projects.name: CyberLake
projects.title: CyberLake
projects.summary: A trust registry for AI agents and MCP servers: each entry carries a signed identity and a capabilities manifest, and is verified before it gets credentials.

projects.name: OpenQR
projects.title: OpenQR
projects.summary: A machine-readable, daily-updated catalog of cryptographic algorithms, their NIST post-quantum status, library support, and migration mappings.

projects.name: OpenQS
projects.title: OpenQS
projects.summary: Finds quantum-vulnerable cryptography in code and infrastructure, produces a cryptography inventory, and gates new uses before merge.

projects.name: OpenQO
projects.title: OpenQO
projects.summary: Automated changes to hybrid post-quantum cryptography, plus ordered certificate and key rotation, with Unasked-style checks on every change.

projects.name: OpenQA
projects.title: OpenQA
projects.summary: Repeatable adversarial suites (prompt injection, unasked edits, tool misuse, risky merges) run in CI, with a scorecard per run.

projects.name: IntentLock
projects.title: IntentLock
projects.summary: Compiles the user's request into a capability envelope of allowed tools, arguments and recipients, and enforces it at an MCP proxy.

projects.name: Taintline
projects.title: Taintline
projects.summary: Labels every span of context by origin and blocks untrusted spans from flowing into sensitive tool-call arguments such as shell commands, URLs and recipients.

projects.name: Airlock
projects.title: Airlock
projects.summary: Runs each risky tool call in a short-lived microVM or WASM sandbox with no network by default, and checks results against policy before merging them back.

projects.name: Rewind
projects.title: Rewind
projects.summary: Records a compensating action for every agent action and rolls back whole sessions across files, git, cloud APIs and SaaS, flagging irreversible actions before they run.

projects.name: Fuse
projects.title: Fuse
projects.summary: Rate, spend and blast-radius limits per agent and per fleet; a tripped limit revokes AgentID credentials in one step and halts dependent agents.

projects.name: AgentChaos
projects.title: AgentChaos
projects.summary: Injects tool timeouts, malformed and poisoned outputs and misbehaving peer agents, then reports whether the agent fails safe, loops, makes things up or cascades.

projects.name: ThreatDiff
projects.title: ThreatDiff
projects.summary: Maps agent configs (prompts, tools, MCP servers, data sources) to attack paths labeled with OWASP Agentic Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS, and gates PRs that open new paths from untrusted input to dangerous actions.

projects.name: OATC
projects.title: OATC
projects.summary: OWASP LLM and Agentic Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS merged and cross-mapped in machine-readable JSON, with each threat mapped to OCBC controls.

projects.name: AgentRisk
projects.title: AgentRisk
projects.summary: One score per agent from its untrusted inputs, tool sensitivity, autonomy and reversibility, so a fleet can be ranked by risk.

projects.name: Tripwire
projects.title: Tripwire
projects.summary: Plants unique synthetic records per permission boundary in vector stores, and reports which boundary failed when one shows up in an output, log or egress.

projects.name: HubScan
projects.title: HubScan
projects.summary: Finds documents that rank highly for far more queries than they should, plus chunks with embedded instructions, without needing attack signatures.

projects.name: ACLDrift
projects.title: ACLDrift
projects.summary: Checks every indexed chunk against the access list of its source document and flags chunks retrievable beyond their original permissions.

experience.title: Principal Software Engineer
outcomes: Built a FedRAMP-compliant Trust Dashboard: secure ingestion and analytics over FedRAMP-authorized vendor APIs, using service-to-service authentication and least-privilege IAM.
Designed a trust engineering framework aligned with NIST 800-53, FedRAMP and Zero Trust that turns real-time signals from Snyk, Qualys, CrowdStrike, Orca and Twistlock into normalized risk models.
Built the Consent & Permission Platform: APIs and event-driven workflows for GDPR, CCPA and FedRAMP privacy compliance, integrated with Salesforce, Adobe Marketo and Alida.
Built ELT pipelines (Airflow, dbt, Fivetran, Snowflake) with schema versioning, data-quality checks and automated compliance validation for security telemetry.
experience.scope: Lead architect for Autodesk's Trust Data Platform and Trust Dashboard, serving FedRAMP and commercial environments.

experience.title: Senior Software Development Engineer

Added centralized logging with the ELK Stack and Kafka, and API caching with Redis and RabbitMQ.
Set up contract and load testing (rest-assured, Gatling) and continuous delivery with Gradle and GoCD.
